136484: Cortech Endurance Bench
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-136484-endurance-bench
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/seating/endurance-bench/
Spec sheets: 136484, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Bench – 136484
Current H1: Cortech Endurance - Patient Seating Bench - One‑Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 136484
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded 48” Bench That Bolts to the Floor, with Optional Cuff Rings
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 136484 Endurance Bench
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Bench is a one-piece molded 48” bench for intake, assessment, and holding areas in correctional facilities, and for waiting rooms, lobbies, and common areas in behavioral healthcare and other secure settings.
The bench is rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components and no seams or fasteners to tamper with. It bolts to the floor through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice, and optional cuff rings can be added to one or both ends.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 48”W×21”D×18”H
Weight: 35 lbs
Mounting: Bolts to the floor through concealed pilot holes (hardware not included); the bench cannot be weighted or filled
Cuff Rings: Optional field-installed cuff rings for one or both ends, sold separately
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
136484 – Bench: 48”W×21”D×18”H, 35 lbs
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through 12 concealed pilot holes with 3/8”-16×3¾” security Torx anchor bolts and flat washers; see Cortech instructions
Cuff Rings: Optional cuff rings install on one or both ends
[H2] Applications
The Endurance Bench suits intake, holding, and waiting areas where seating must stay fixed in place and resist tampering.
Typical applications include:
Intake, assessment, and holding areas in correctional facilities and jails
Waiting rooms and lobbies in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Common areas in residential treatment centers and other secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (52 characters): Cortech Endurance Molded Bench - 136484 at Anchortex
Meta description (152 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Bench. A one-piece molded 48” bench that bolts to the floor for intake, holding, and waiting areas, with optional cuff rings.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out "Patient Seating," "One-Piece Rotationally Molded," and "Model."
Weight: your variant is set to 50 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 35 lbs, so I used 35 lbs.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 6 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
UV stabilized: your current page says "Optional: UV stabilized." Cortech does not say this for the bench, so I left it out.
Weighting: the Cortech web page says the bench cannot be weighted or filled, so I added this to the Mounting bullet.
Cuff rings: Cortech calls them cuff rings (web page) and field-installed restraint rings (spec sheet), and does not give them a model number. I used "cuff rings."
Installation hardware: the Cortech spec sheet says hardware of your choice. The bolt sizes in the Installation section come from the Cortech installation instructions.
I left out "Stain resistant" and "can be wiped, mopped, or even hosed down," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these.
GREENGUARD Gold: this comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention it.
Product images: the page has two images. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
